purpose: Make a conversational comparison or inference.
keywords: Plain clause / noun + みたいだ.
That cloud looks like an animal.
It seems someone is in the next room.
It looks like the place is closed today.
Share information or express your own impression
formation: Plain clause / noun + みたいだ.
restrictions: Can express resemblance or an evidence-based impression; it is less formal than ようだ.
mistake: Do not insert だ after a noun immediately before みたい.
